messages.subject: SCR with discrete irregular state space
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to fit this SCR model with discrete space in nimble, and I am getting an error message: Error in envRefInferField(x, what, getClass(class(x)), selfEnv) :‘Sgrid’ is not a valid field or method name for reference class “code_MID_2_modelClass_UID_17_UID_18”

I am having issues trying to define the state space using xy coordinates of all cells of a grid (matrix Sgrid), instead of x and y limits - my state space area is irregular, and will also have an habitat covariate (forest type) associated with each grid cell.

Here is the code:

code <- nimbleCode({
   
    lam0 ~ dunif(0,5)
    sigma ~ dunif(0,5)
    psi ~ dunif(0,1)

    for(i in 1:M) {
       z[i] ~ dbern(psi)
       s[i] ~ dcat(probs[1:nPix])
       x0g[i] <- Sgrid[s[i],1]            ## get the xy coordinates of the s[i] pixel
       y0g[i] <- Sgrid[s[i],2]  
       for(j in 1:J) {                     
          dist[i,j] <- (x0g[i] - X[j,1])^2 + (y0g[i] - X[j,2])^2
          lam[i,j] <- lam0*exp(-dist[i,j]/(2*sigma^2))*z[i]
          y[i,j]~ dpois(lam[i,j]*K)
       }
    }
    N<- sum(z[1:M])
})

constants <- list(M=M,                 ## agumented individuals
                          K=K,                 ## effort
                          J=J,                  ## ntraps
                          Sgrid=Sgrid,      ## grid coordinates
                          nPix=nPix)        ## number of cells on grid

data <- list(y=y,                          ## capture history (ind x J)
                  X=X,                         ## trap coordinates
                  probs=probs)            ## prob of si be in each grid cell
  
## Initial values
initscoord <- X[sample(dim(X)[1],M,replace=TRUE),1:2]
sst <- rep(0,dim(initscoord)[1])
for(i in 1:length(sst)) {
    sst[i] <- which(apply(Sgrid,1,identical,initscoord[i,]))
}
z <- rep(1,M)

inits <- list (sigma=0.5, lam0=0.1, psi=0.5, s=sst, z=z)

Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code=code, constants=constants, data=data, inits=inits)

Thank you, and my apologies if this is a repeated posting.

Bruna Amaral
